articles.title: AI race heats up as OpenAI flags alleged model-copying campaign
articles.description: OpenAI says it identified an attempt to extract protected reasoning from its AI models, linking part of the activity with China’s Moonshot AI.

articles.title: Trump’s AI lunch included every major tech company. Except Apple
articles.description: Apple's absence from Trump's AI lunch raised eyebrows, but the company is known to look out for its own interests.

articles.title: Passengers and crew foil co-pilot's apparent attempt to crash FlyDubai flight to Israel
articles.description: One of the pilots on a FlyDubai flight headed for Israel stabbed the second pilot, according to Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

articles.title: CFTC seeks to define event contracts as swaps amid prediction market fight
articles.description: The classification could assist the CFTC’s claim that it has exclusive federal jurisdiction over event contracts offered on regulated prediction markets.

articles.title: Inside India newsletter: Foreign insurers get the red-carpet treatment — and policy uncertainty
articles.description: Foreign insurers brace for another set of policy changes in India's insurance market.

articles.title: MetaMask exits Ethereum validators amid undisclosed security incident
articles.description: MetaMask said it is investigating the threat internally and said it has found no immediate threat to its wallets.

articles.title: California Gov. Gavin Newsom bans AI 'robo bosses' in landmark state law, reversing his earlier veto
articles.description: California Governor Gavin Newsom has banned 'robo-bosses' from firing workers, the first U.S. state with such a law.

articles.title: Fed's Kashkari says inflation is 'still too high' even after softer-than-expected PCE data, labor market is 'pretty good'
articles.description: Kashkari sat down with CNBC's Steve Liesman for an exclusive conversation Wednesday night.

articles.title: Gemini 4 Is Here, and Google’s Flagship Tops All Other AI Models on Cybersecurity
articles.description: Gemini 4 Argon tops 12 of 18 benchmarks in Google's own table, writes a million tokens per reply and resists hijacking best. Cyber defenders get it first, with the guardrails off.

articles.title: David Ellison names Ynon Kreiz co-CEO of Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery
articles.description: Paramount CEO David Ellison announced outgoing Mattel chief Ynon Kreiz will serve as the co-CEO of the anticipated combination of Paramount and WBD.

articles.title: Cramer says 'frozen' conditions are holding many stocks back. Here's what could change that
articles.description: CNBC's Jim Cramer said Wednesday that several key parts of the U.S. economy have effectively frozen.

articles.title: Trump 'thinking about' diesel export ban, but says it could have 'negative impact' on gasoline
articles.description: Trump recently said he was "very seriously" considering a diesel export ban, despite warnings from the U.S. oil industry that doing so would raise prices.

articles.title: Eli Lilly says closely watched combo obesity regimen boosts weight loss in mid-stage trial
articles.description: Lilly said it plans to start Phase 3 trials on the combo regimen adding its amylin drug eloralintide to tirzepatide at the end of the year.

articles.title: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Argon, its most advanced AI model
articles.description: Gemini 4 Argon is Alphabet's most advanced model yet, with major coding, cybersecurity, and complex professional work improvements.

articles.title: Treasury launches student loan support center as new data show 9.3 million borrowers in default
articles.description: The Trump administration announced on Wednesday that it was launching a "Default Loans Support Center" for student loan borrowers who've fallen behind.

articles.title: Trump administration starts sending $500 Obamacare refund checks — who stands to benefit
articles.description: The refunds come after millions of people lost premium subsidies for their health insurance and right before the midterm elections.

articles.title: Dogecoin Is Getting Apps as DogeOS Opens Its Public Testnet
articles.description: The team behind the MyDoge wallet opened a public test of DogeOS, a layer that lets developers build lending platforms and games on top of the meme coin network.

articles.title: Meta stock enjoys best month since 2022 on AI momentum
articles.description: Meta stock had its best month in almost four years as investors cheer the social media giant's recent momentum in artificial intelligence.

articles.title: Elon Musk, Palmer Luckey and Newt Gingrich to help Pentagon with warfare initiative, Hegseth says
articles.description: Pete Hegseth, in remarks about the state of the military, announced a project led by two GOP-supporting tech executives to examine military capabilities.

articles.title: FBI Tells Its Employees to Assume Hackers Have Their Personal Data
articles.description: An internal memo warned FBI staff that ShinyHunters, the group claiming it hacked the bureau's jobs site, may hold their private details.
